source_of_scope: Existing frozen product boundary in STATUS.md

requirements: Windows desktop product exposes the four frozen entries through Service-layer behavior.
Core activity analysis uses real production market data and persists RAW/validated business evidence.
Public Level-1 data may describe observable price/volume/turnover activity but must not claim actor identity.
One-click update uses an independent updater and remains BLOCKED without trusted production Release N→N+1 context.
One-click repair protects user data and repairs configuration/storage/cache/index integrity without delete-all shortcuts.
Advanced analysis preserves the identity, advice and capital-deployment risk boundaries.
Capital deployment remains disabled until the complete frozen engineering and business acceptance contract passes.
requirements_purpose_model.business_purpose: Provide reproducible, evidence-backed research on observable market activity while preventing public Level-1 data, unqualified models, candidate artifacts or partial tests from being represented as real-money readiness.
success_criteria: Every frozen engineering and business gate is explicit and evidence-backed.
The same final Windows EXE passes real network, physical GUI and Same Hash.
A real signed independent Release N→N+1 update and rollback chain is verified.
No model or capital-deployment readiness is promoted without complete business qualification.
failure_criteria: Any required gate is FAIL, NOT VERIFIED or BLOCKED.
Public Level-1 data is promoted to identity-grade capital attribution.
A candidate or historical artifact is treated as Final.
Update, GUI, real-network or Same-Hash evidence does not bind to the accepted product bytes.

five_why.question: Why build the system?
five_why.answer: To turn observable market activity into a reproducible research workflow instead of ad-hoc interpretation.

five_why.question: Why require real sources, validation and evidence?
five_why.answer: Because stale, malformed, cached or synthetic inputs can create false confidence while still allowing code to run.

five_why.question: Why keep an identity boundary on public Level-1 data?
five_why.answer: Because price, volume and turnover do not identify the actual actor, so identity-grade conclusions would be unsupported.

five_why.question: Why require cost, leakage, survivorship and statistical qualification before capital deployment?
five_why.answer: Because apparent historical gains can disappear after realistic execution, point-in-time controls and independent out-of-sample testing.

five_why.question: Why require Exact EXE, physical GUI, Same Hash and real Release N→N+1 evidence?
five_why.answer: Because source-level success does not prove that the exact delivered Windows product and updater perform the accepted behavior.

invariants: DailyBar provenance includes provider and raw payload SHA-256.
CapitalObservation exposes observable activity while true capital identity remains unavailable from public Level-1.
Validated storage is required before analysis; insufficient current data fails closed.
Capital-deployment readiness is outside a PASS path until full acceptance.

function_inventory.acceptance: signed N→N+1 download, verify, backup, atomic replace, health, GUI acknowledgment, rollback and re-download Same Hash
